title: GdprDataProtectionByDesign
description: GDPR-sourced archetype — data protection by design and by default under Regulation (EU) 2016/679. Article 25 requires controllers to implement appropriate technical and organisational measures at the time of determination of means and at the time of processing itself. Rootless — regulatory compliance dimension. Source: GDPR Article 25(1)-(2).

technicalMeasuresImplemented.description: Whether appropriate technical measures (e.g., pseudonymisation, encryption, access controls) have been implemented to ensure data protection principles are embedded in processing. Source: GDPR Art 25(1).

organisationalMeasuresImplemented.description: Whether appropriate organisational measures (e.g., policies, training, governance procedures) have been implemented. Source: GDPR Art 25(1).

pseudonymisationApplied.description: Whether pseudonymisation has been applied as a technical measure. Pseudonymisation is explicitly mentioned in Art 25(1) as an example of an appropriate measure.

defaultDataMinimisation.description: Whether, by default, only personal data which are necessary for each specific purpose of processing are processed. Applies to amount collected, extent of processing, storage period, and accessibility. Source: GDPR Art 25(2).

processingLimitedByDefault.description: Whether personal data are not made accessible by default to an indefinite number of natural persons without the individual's intervention. Source: GDPR Art 25(2).

stateOfArtConsidered.description: Whether the state of the art, cost of implementation, nature/scope/context/purposes of processing, and risks of varying likelihood and severity have been taken into account. Source: GDPR Art 25(1).
